title: On Deciding the matter before dusk
subtitle: 决策选择 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 决策选择（做人与做事·选择与决定）
meta: 主题语境：决策选择（做人与做事·选择与决定）　|　核心词汇：decide　|　正文 335 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 decide 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1960 the keeper ① decided the matter before dusk in silence, and every traveller in the tower said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the keeper ② decides the matter before dusk twice over without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ decide the matter before dusk at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ decided the matter before dusk before — a line in the calendar for January 1954 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Deciding the matter before dusk in silence, the keeper said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the clock at the far stair, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ decide in favour of the younger man twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Decide in favour of the younger man at once and never mention it again.

By 1967 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the calendar, and a new traveller from the next tower ⑧ decides in favour of the younger man in silence every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the stair, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ decided the matter before dusk again when nobody else would.

⑩ To decide the matter before dusk, my mother said in 1972, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the tower remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the tower forgets, somebody decides the matter before dusk twice over again and somebody must decide the matter before dusk in silence all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 决定（一般过去式 decided the matter before dusk：1960 年守夜人头一回这样做，一言不发地）
B. v. 决定（一般现在 decides the matter before dusk：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 决定（不定式 to decide the matter before dusk：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 决定（过去完成时 had decided the matter before dusk：1954 年一月的年历上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 决定（动名词 deciding the matter before dusk 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 裁决（decide in favour of the younger man：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去裁决判给那个年轻人）
G. v. 裁决（decide in favour of the younger man：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 决定（后段两处：新来的过路人照例 decides in favour of the younger man，而母亲又一次 decided the matter before dusk）

items.q: to decide the matter before dusk
decided the matter before dusk before
decide in favour of the younger man twice over
decide in favour of the younger man at once
decides in favour of the younger man in silence
decided the matter before dusk again
to decide the matter before dusk

answers.why: decide 意为“决定”，1960 年守夜人一言不发地决定天黑前把这件事定下来，那是钟楼里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 decided。
decide 意为“决定”，自那以后守夜人来回两遍把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 decides。
decide 意为“决定”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯决定天黑前把这件事定下来”，此处为不定式 to decide the matter before dusk。
decide 意为“决定”，年历里 一月 那行字说明早在 1967 年之前就有人决定过，故用过去完成时 had decided。
decide 意为“决定”，守夜人说“决定天黑前把这件事定下来这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 deciding the matter before dusk 作主语。
decide 意为“裁决”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去裁决判给那个年轻人”，should ever 之后用原形 decide in favour of the younger man。
decide 意为“裁决”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻裁决判给那个年轻人（decide in favour of the younger man at once），以后再也不要提起。
decide 意为“决定”，新来的过路人每个年头都照例裁决判给那个年轻人，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 decides。
decide 意为“决定”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次一言不发地决定天黑前把这件事定下来，用一般过去式 decided 叙述。
decide 意为“决定”，结尾那句是母亲 1972 年的话：要决定天黑前把这件事定下来，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和钟楼记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1960 年，守夜人一言不发地决定天黑前把这件事定下来；钟楼里每一个过路人都说这是头一回。（decided the matter before dusk）
多年以后，守夜人仍来回两遍做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（decides the matter before dusk）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯决定天黑前把这件事定下来这件事本身。（to decide the matter before dusk）
早在 1954 年就有人决定天黑前把这件事定下来，一月那天年历上的一行字就是证据。（had decided the matter before dusk）
守夜人说过，一言不发地决定天黑前把这件事定下来这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（deciding the matter before dusk 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻裁决判给那个年轻人，以后再也不要提起。（decide in favour of the younger man，祈使句）
answers: In 1960 the keeper decided the matter before dusk in silence, and every traveller in the tower said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three years on, the keeper still decides the matter before dusk twice over without being asked.
My mother said later that to decide the matter before dusk at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had decided the matter before dusk long before 1967, and the line in the calendar for January proves it.
Deciding the matter before dusk in silence, the keeper said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: Decide in favour of the younger man at once and never mention it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 decide 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1960 the keeper decided the matter before dusk in silence, and nobody in the tower forgot it.
Even now the keeper decides the matter before dusk twice over whenever the tower asks.
Deciding the matter before dusk in silence, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever decide in favour of the younger man twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new traveller from the next tower decides in favour of the younger man in silence every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother decided the matter before dusk again, and the tower remembered that half.
